github_pages_same_origin.economic_risk: no_direct_variable_request_billing_model_for_this_deployment; GitHub Pages usage limits still apply

url_strategy: Resolve immutable PMTiles location from a versioned manifest or asset-base configuration; do not distribute hardcoded host URLs throughout runtime logic.
review_triggers: measured GitHub Pages bandwidth approaches its documented soft limit
published artifact approaches its documented site-size limit or deployments become unreliable
multiple large national assets make Pages artifacts operationally cumbersome
production requires explicit cache-control, purge or domain controls unavailable in the selected Pages workflow
observed traffic or maintenance needs justify accepting R2 subscription and usage monitoring

staging.pages: retain isolated technical staging repository temporarily; review housekeeping after production-hosting decision
staging.r2: retain r2.dev object only as technical staging evidence; do not treat it as production and review retention later

blockers: No technical hosting blocker for a future Pages-based production migration
Production migration design remains intentionally unstarted
